title: 20-Layer Dual-Band Filter with Reduced Perturbation and Outer-Layer Locking
scientific_hypothesis: Reducing thickness perturbation bounds by 50% around iteration_15's best candidate (65/114/77/93/69/108/70/96/66/67/42/83/51/89/60/67/46/70/50/70 nm) while freezing outer 4 layers after 2 optimization iterations will improve convergence stability and maintain dual-band performance without degrading the 0.909 target score baseline.
design_principle: Local exploitation with constrained search space: tight bounds prevent escape from proven high-performing region; outer-layer locking reduces effective dimensionality and prevents edge-effect instability during late-stage optimization.
proposed_topology: 20 finite layers: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2 on fused silica substrate, air superstrate
design_variables: Outer 4 layers (2 top + 2 bottom) locked after iteration 2
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band
Maximize mean reflectance in 400-700 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Relative uniform thickness tolerance ±20% for robustness evaluation
Outer layers frozen to reduce deposition sequence sensitivity
theory_basis: Transfer-matrix method for coherent multilayer interference
Quarter-wave stack theory for broadband reflection
expected_advantages: Faster convergence due to reduced search space
known_risks: Over-constraining may prevent discovery of better local optimum
Outer-layer locking may reduce ability to correct edge impedance mismatch
execution_request_english: Design and optimize a 20-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with air superstrate. Initialize thicknesses at [65, 114, 77, 93, 69, 108, 70, 96, 66, 67, 42, 83, 51, 89, 60, 67, 46, 70, 50, 70] nm (iteration_15 best candidate). Apply optimization bounds of ±15 nm (50% reduction from iteration_15's ±30 nm). Implement cooldown schedule: after 2 optimization iterations, lock layers 1-2 and 19-20 (outermost 4 layers) at their current values. Optimize remaining 16 layers using gradient_thickness optimizer. Evaluate at normal incidence, unpolarized light, coherent assumption across all layers. Spectrum: 400-1600 nm with 2001 points. Objectives: maximize mean transmittance in 1530-1565 nm, maximize mean reflectance in 400-700 nm. Robustness: relative uniform thickness uncertainty ±20% across 400-1600 nm. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1530-1565 nm, 400-700 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band; High reflectance in 400-700 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band; Low transmittance in 400-700 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count <= 30.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive: 50% perturbation reduction (±30nm to ±15nm) and outer-layer locking after 2 iterations. Builds on iteration_15's best_target_score=0.9094 while adding convergence stability mechanisms.
